scope.boundary: This audit validates retained source integrity and disclosure scope only. It does not choose a product, generate a result forecast, establish current tradability, or authorize an external action.

methods.name: C30/C31 exact-code comparison
methods.evidence: C30 source.allowed_codes, C31 scope.c30_actual_instruments, and C31 lean_research_core.codes each equal the same five-code set.

methods.name: Path and digest recomputation
methods.evidence: Every C31 source_ref for the five actual-core codes is present; each cited product-summary SHA-256 equals the local raw PDF digest.

methods.name: Upstream source-freeze verification
methods.evidence: The R4 manifest digest is fa0a864bebca0881b9809176038e88d64cc87563038737a554609b255afa73db and P01's independent core-diligence verifier returned PASS.

methods.name: Document-text and venue-master scope check
methods.evidence: Retained master responses support code, manager, trustee, listing date and available index labels; product summaries support their own document-dated legal type, exposure, replication, fees and risks. The sources do not establish later terms or any live market or execution field.

methods.name: SSE ETF FAQ category-mechanics check
methods.evidence: The retained FAQ supports the stated 100-unit and CNY0.001 references and category-level T+0/T+1 distinction, but not product-, account- or session-specific facts.

methods.name: Automated local consistency screen
methods.evidence: The stock-oriented CLI produced zero conflicts for the observed 510300 run but marked its quote source unavailable. It is not a direct validator of retained SSE ETF product facts and cannot close C31's live-market gap. Manual source checking is controlling.

findings.item: No current legal-document and temporary-announcement chain is verified for the five actual-core codes at the 2026-08-15 cutoff.
findings.reported: C31 labels all product-summary facts as document-dated and says current terms remain unverified.
findings.actual: The retained product summaries are 57 to 420 days before the cutoff; the 511990 summary is 420 days before the cutoff.
findings.source: C31 evidence_boundary; five retained product summaries; each summary's update notice.
findings.impact: The dated facts remain valid only for the stated document date. They cannot make a later C33 record or R15 disposition eligible.
findings.remediation: For each affected record, retain the current legal document and relevant temporary-announcement check with timestamp and hash; otherwise record no_action.

findings.item: No timestamped product-level live market, account, fee, settlement, quote, depth, IOPV-when-applicable, or fill evidence is retained.
findings.reported: C31 expressly excludes live price, NAV, IOPV, premium or discount, spread, depth, halt, price-limit, friction, fill and settlement evidence.
findings.actual: The retained master responses, product summaries and FAQ are not a session-specific market or execution record.
findings.source: C31 evidence_boundary and universal_market_mechanics; R4 source-manifest limitations; FAQ scope.
findings.impact: No current tradability or paper-execution result may be inferred from C31.
findings.remediation: C33 must independently retain timestamped status, quote, depth, IOPV when applicable, account, fee, tax, lot/tick, settlement and explicit fill-or-no_action fields for every planned action.

findings.item: No corporate-action, tax, distribution or return-adjusted total-return ledger is retained for the actual-core set.
findings.reported: C31 expressly states that a corporate-action and return-adjusted total-return ledger is not verified.
findings.actual: Product documents and venue-master rows contain no complete return-adjustment ledger.
findings.source: C31 evidence_boundary; upstream R4 manifest limitations.
findings.impact: No performance or total-return conclusion may be carried from this product-diligence packet.
findings.remediation: Keep the VETO in R15 unless a complete, date-aligned total-return and event-treatment ledger is independently sourced and verified.

findings.item: C31 cites individual venue-master paths but stores their digests only indirectly through the inherited R4 manifest.
findings.reported: C31 gives exact paths and identifies R4-M; the upstream manifest carries the individual file digests.
findings.actual: All five master paths are present and their retained manifest entries match their recomputed digests.
findings.impact: No dated-fact contradiction was found; downstream traceability is slightly less self-contained.
findings.remediation: C33/R15 should retain the upstream manifest path and digest alongside any reused master-response reference.

confirmed_correct.item: All five C31 actual-core source paths exist

confirmed_correct.value: 5 of 5 product cards supported at their document dates
confirmed_correct.verified_source: Product-summary text, venue-master responses and R4 manifest

confirmed_correct.value: FAQ facts are used only as category-level references
C30 and both C31 core lists match exactly; 510500, 511180 and 511380 remain non-core
Current-term, live-market, execution and total-return gaps are explicitly disclosed

c33_requirements: Use only the exact five-code set; do not add or replace an instrument with 510500, 511180 or 511380.
Treat C31 only as historical product-identity evidence. Set each current-term and execution field to false until separately evidenced for that record.
If any current document, announcement, market-status, quote, depth, IOPV-when-applicable, account, fee, tax, lot/tick, settlement or reconciliation field is absent, record no_action.
Do not book a target as a fill and do not use C31 to supply a missing price, cost, settlement or return field.
r15_requirements: Retain the VETO while C36-S-001 through C36-S-003 remain open.
Do not reinterpret document-dated product facts as current terms, current tradability, execution evidence or total-return evidence.
Reference this C36 artifact and the upstream R4 manifest in any evidence-completion review.
